name: Phone Harness
long_description: Phone Harness is the most popular open-source harness for phone automation with 3,800+ GitHub stars. We enable agents to tap, type, and scroll on your personal phone or cloud-hosted phones. Supports iPhone and Android. No jailbreak, API, or app installation needed.

launches.title: Phone Harness: Let your agent tap, scroll, and type on your iPhone or Android
launches.tagline: Let your agent use your personal phone, or its own iPhone/Android in the cloud
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Phone Harness lets your AI agent tap, scroll, and type on a real phone, either your own iPhone or Android or a Phone Harness Cloud phone. Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Instinct, Hermes, or any agent can use real mobile apps, 24/7.

<https://youtu.be/-3MiCLiQzdA>

## What it does

* **Open-source harness (4K+ GitHub stars, MIT):** Hook up any agent to your own phone. iPhone works through iPhone Mirroring on your Mac, Android over adb. No jailbreak, nothing to install on the phone.
* **Phone Harness Cloud:** Real iPhones and Androids your agent uses from anywhere. Phones stay on 24/7 and keep their logins between runs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125453&key=user_uploads/2048642/d080930b-e034-4b4f-a9a6-9f57ff8d1949)

## What a real phone unlocks

* **Apps that only exist on mobile.** Plenty of apps have no web version, or a much worse one. If it runs on a phone, your agent can use it.
* **Stay logged in.** Mobile apps keep you signed in for months, so your agent isn’t re-authenticating on every run.
* **Close the loop.** Your agent can test mobile apps and read its own SMS or 2FA codes, so complex workflows finish end to end without a human stepping in.
* **A real device.** Apps treat it like any normal user’s phone.

## Give your agent a phone

Try it now: go to [phone-harness.com](https://phone-harness.com) and send your agent the setup prompt. If you’re building always-on, computer-use agents or an in-house phone farm, [grab a time](https://cal.com/shawnpana/phone-harness-demo) and I’ll set you up with a cloud phone.

Shawn
